newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Fipe inflation at 0.16 pct Feb 15-MArch 15.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Fipe inflation at 0.16 pct Feb 15-MArch 15.

text.p: Brazilian inflation as measured by the Economic Research Institute (Fipe) rose 0.16 percent in the Feb 15-March 15 period, a Fipe official said.
Price growth was mainly held down by lower costs for clothing, which fell 4.29 percent, and education, down 0.06 percent in the period, said Fipe President Juarez Rizzieri.
Rizzieri said the Fipe index was expected to rise about 0.30 percent in the month of March.
Fipe also released the following breakdown of its weighted inflation index:
-Personal expenses: 0.03 percent rise in the period
-Health care: 0.64 percent rise in the period
